details: The package's preinstall hook runs an obfuscated setup script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun and executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload (math_init.js) containing eval/Function/child_process calls. The package also depends on the known-malicious packages @or-sdk/base and @or-sdk/sdk-api. Installing this package executes an obfuscated second-stage payload at install time; the payload's network endpoints are hidden behind the obfuscation.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
